shared_elements: repeated rounded or rectangular motifs in an upper row
horizontal band of repeated V/triangle/chevron-like pattern
justification: The strongest correspondence is the stacked composition with an upper row of rounded/rectangular forms, a narrow horizontal chevron-like band beneath it, and larger profile figural imagery below. The biggest difference is that A is a broad, very weathered shallow carving on a flat slab, while B is a clearer, more deeply modelled vertical pillar with additional distinct lower scenes and sharper individual figures.
